title: Introduction to Psychiatry
description: Concise Year 4 foundation notes: what psychiatry and mental health mean, the role of psychiatric assessment, and core clinical principles. Links to existing psychopathology and biopsychosocial notes to avoid duplication.

title: Classification of Mental Disorders
description: Year 4 psychiatry presentation notes: what classification means, ICD-11 versus DSM-5-TR, the major categories, symptom versus syndrome versus disorder, limitations, and what a diagnosis does and does not tell us.

title: Introduction to Psychopathology
description: Year 4 psychiatry presentation notes: the language of abnormal mental experience: the mental state domains, form versus content of thought, delusion versus hallucination versus illusion, mood versus affect, insight.

title: Dictionary of Psychopathology
description: Year 4 psychiatry reference: 80+ psychopathology terms defined in plain words and grouped by mood and affect, form and content of thought, perception, movement and behaviour, and memory and insight, with practice questions and MCQs.

title: Fundamentals of Psychopathology
description: Year 4 psychiatry lecture notes (Dr Linet Kendi, MKU): phenomenology, classification, signs symptoms and syndromes, disorders of thought, perception, mood, psychomotor behaviour, speech, memory and cognition, DSM-5-TR and ICD-11, with practice questions and MCQs.

title: Introduction to Psychopharmacology
description: Year 4 psychiatry notes following the MKU course outline: pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, neurotransmitters, the four dopamine pathways, antidepressants, antipsychotics, anxiolytics and hypnotics, mood stabilisers, ADHD drugs, special populations, adherence, polypharmacy and stigma, with practice questions and MCQs.

title: Psychological Therapies and Non-Pharmacological Interventions
description: Year 4 psychiatry notes on CBT, behaviour therapy, IPT, psychodynamic, family and group therapy, motivational interviewing, mindfulness, relaxation, occupational and community approaches, with what each targets, plus practice questions and MCQs.

title: Psychiatry and Mental Health Curriculum: Year 4 (MKU)
description: The MKU Year 4 Junior Clerkship in Psychiatry and Mental Health: unit codes MBPS 4537 and 4539, learning outcomes, course outline, clinical processes, assessment (30/10/60) and reading list.

title: Biopsychosocial Formulation
description: Year 4 psychiatry presentation notes: what a formulation is, formulation versus diagnosis, the biological, psychological and social domains, the 4Ps grid, and a worked case.

title: Psychiatry, Sociology, Anthropology and Psychology
description: How psychiatry draws on psychology, sociology and anthropology, and how mental, physical and social aspects of health interact.

title: Are Human Beings Thinkers with Emotions, or Emotional Thinkers?
description: A balanced discussion from philosophy, neuroscience (Damasio, dual-process theory) and psychiatry on the relationship between thought and emotion.

title: Bipolar and Related Disorders
description: Year 4 psychiatry notes in 14 parts: mood versus affect, classification, mania, hypomania, major depression, bipolar I versus II, cyclothymia, differential diagnosis, investigations, acute and maintenance treatment, and the cost of untreated illness, with practice questions.

title: Pneumonia
description: Pneumonia: classification, causes, clinical features, CURB-65 severity, investigations, antibiotic management, complications and prevention, with practice questions.

title: Pleural Effusion
description: Pleural effusion: transudate versus exudate and Light's criteria, causes, clinical features, investigations including pleural fluid analysis, and management.

title: Pneumothorax
description: Pneumothorax: primary, secondary, traumatic and tension types, clinical features, X-ray size, and BTS management including needle decompression and chest drain.

title: Asthma
description: Asthma: pathophysiology, diagnosis, severity of acute attacks, emergency treatment and the long-term stepwise management.

title: Bronchitis (Acute and Chronic)
description: Acute and chronic bronchitis: causes, features, how to tell it from pneumonia, when antibiotics are and are not needed.

title: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
description: COPD: causes including biomass smoke, GOLD spirometry grades, stable-disease treatment, long-term oxygen, and managing an acute exacerbation.

title: Bronchiectasis
description: Bronchiectasis: causes, the vicious cycle, HRCT findings, airway clearance and antibiotic management, and complications.

title: Lung Abscess
description: Lung abscess: aspiration and other causes, anaerobic organisms, features, imaging, prolonged antibiotics and drainage.

title: Interstitial Lung Diseases
description: Interstitial lung disease: classification, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, sarcoidosis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, HRCT patterns, restrictive lung function and treatment.

title: Occupational Lung Disease
description: Occupational lung disease: silicosis, asbestosis, coal and organic dust diseases, occupational asthma, taking an occupational history, prevention and compensation.

title: DVT and Venous Thromboembolism (with Pulmonary Embolism)
description: DVT, VTE and pulmonary embolism: Virchow's triad, Wells scores, D-dimer and imaging, anticoagulation, massive PE and prophylaxis.

title: Lung Cancer
description: Lung cancer: risk factors, small cell versus non-small cell types, clinical and paraneoplastic features, investigations, staging and treatment.
